post.title: Monitoring Company Earnings Releases with WebMonitor.fyi
post.description: Discover how to use WebMonitor.fyi to stay updated on company earnings releases. Receive instant alerts on financial results that impact your investment decisions.
post.author: David Lee

body.raw:
## Introduction

Company earnings releases provide crucial insights into financial performance, guiding investors in their decision-making process. These releases can significantly impact stock prices and market perceptions. Manually tracking earnings announcements can be tedious. With WebMonitor.fyi, you can automate the monitoring of earnings releases and receive timely notifications. This guide will walk you through setting up monitors for company earnings releases.


## Why Monitor Earnings Releases?

Monitoring earnings releases helps you:



- Make Informed Decisions: Understand a company's financial health and performance trends.

- Identify Investment Opportunities: Act on positive results or adjust your strategy based on negative performance.

- Stay Ahead of Market Movements: Anticipate stock price fluctuations following earnings announcements.




## How WebMonitor.fyi Can Help

WebMonitor.fyi offers AI-powered monitoring for earnings releases:



- Automated Tracking: Monitor company investor relations pages or financial news sites for earnings announcements.

- Custom Criteria: Specify keywords or phrases to focus on specific aspects, like "exceeds expectations" or "revenue growth".

- Instant Alerts: Receive notifications immediately after the release is published.




## Step-by-Step Guide to Monitoring Earnings Releases


### Step 1: Identify Companies and Sources to Monitor

List the companies you're interested in and locate their investor relations websites or preferred financial news outlets.


### Step 2: Obtain the URL for Earnings Releases

Navigate to the page where the company publishes its earnings releases. Copy the URL of this page.


### Step 3: Log In to WebMonitor.fyi

Log in to your WebMonitor.fyi account. Sign up if you haven't already.


### Step 4: Create a New Monitor

Click "Add New Monitor" and paste the URL into the URL field.


### Step 5: Define Your Monitoring Criteria

Set your criteria using natural language:



- "Notify me when a new earnings release is published."

- "Alert me if the earnings per share (EPS) is above $2.00."

- "Inform me when revenue growth exceeds 10%."




### Step 6: Choose Monitoring Frequency

Earnings releases are typically quarterly. A daily check is sufficient, but you may choose a higher frequency during earnings season.


### Step 7: Configure Notifications

Select your preferred notification method.


### Step 8: Save and Activate Your Monitor

Click "Save" to start monitoring.


## Tips for Effective Monitoring



- Monitor Analyst Reports: Set up monitors for analyst updates to gauge market reactions.

- Use Specific Metrics: Focus on the financial metrics most relevant to your investment strategy.

- Combine Sources: Monitor both company websites and financial news sites for comprehensive coverage.




## Conclusion

Automating the monitoring of company earnings releases with WebMonitor.fyi ensures you never miss critical financial updates. Stay informed and make timely investment decisions based on the latest information. Start using WebMonitor.fyi to enhance your financial market monitoring today.


## Additional Resources

Explore more ways to use WebMonitor.fyi:



- Monitoring SEC Filings with WebMonitor.fyi

- Enhance Your Competitive Intelligence with WebMonitor.fyi
